title: read-as-book
summary: A drop-in "Read as book" page turner that lets any website show a PDF as a full-screen book with page curl, plus a React component and a PDF-to-pages CLI.

contribution.roleNote: Extracted from the Ethical Tech CoLab website, where it powers the report readers.

narrative.problem: Sites that publish reports as PDFs, such as the Ethical Tech CoLab website, want readers to flip through them like a real book, on static hosts such as GitHub Pages, Netlify or S3, without a server or a PDF renderer in the page.
narrative.decision: Pages are plain images pre-rendered from the PDF at build time by the included CLI, so the browser never loads pdf.js, the book opens instantly, and it works on a purely static host.
narrative.tradeoff: Very long documents become many image files, and because the aspect ratio is taken from page 1, a PDF with mixed page sizes will letterbox.
narrative.limitation: The README offers a GitHub install for when the package is not on npm; the repository's checks are a typecheck plus a CLI smoke test, and the bundled example runs on generated placeholder pages.
